steps.title: Two curves
steps.say: Demand slopes down: buyers want more at a lower price. Supply slopes up: sellers offer more at a higher price.

steps.title: Where they cross
steps.say: The price where the two curves cross is the equilibrium. At price 5 buyers want exactly the quantity sellers offer, which is 5.

steps.title: Why the price settles there
steps.say: If the price is above 5, sellers offer more than buyers want, so there is a surplus and sellers cut the price. If it is below 5, buyers want more than is offered, so there is a shortage and the price rises.

steps.title: Curves move, price follows
steps.say: When something other than price changes what buyers want or sellers offer, the whole curve shifts. The price and quantity then move to a new crossing point.

steps.title: Quiz: supply falls
steps.say: Supply has fallen by 2, so the supply curve has moved left. Drag the dot to where you think the new equilibrium is.
